record: E-01 as-run method and environment configuration (public derivation)
derivation: Derived from the project's reviewed, frozen E-01 configuration (private record, SHA256 813a28c7f658d5414401c6ec44abf80f87166071a35e92557d33fc1657961da8) and the reviewed installed-environment records (package receipt SHA256 4e080247aaed75c151b029564673c1d5c8204e110ec239a233fadc3265eb8b59; baseline hash set SHA256 45170652a4579319085a42cf9f1109b11ea52e0beb982439c4ac64eceb617d2a). Internal status annotations, review references, local paths and orchestration details were removed; the values below are unchanged. This is the configuration the run used; the earlier prospective protocol is docs/e01-method-specification.md.

engine.distribution: conda-forge, platforms osx-arm64 and noarch, 94 packages in a project-local prefix

installed_file_deviation.difference: the only difference found is the TH-FL entry, which reads LDA_XC_TH_FL instead of GGA_XC_TH_FL; the wB97X-D3 entry is unchanged
installed_file_deviation.limitation: this establishes no equivalence of the selected functional with any literature or benchmark functional

engine.integrity_scope: Package identity (name, version, build, channel, URL, MD5, SHA256) was checked for all 94 packages against the installation receipt; installed-file bytes were checked only for the files listed above.

method.dispersion: D3 zero damping, configured through the Psi4 1.11 route d3zero2b to simple-dftd3; three-body term off; parameters printed at E-01 setup s6 1.0, s8 1.0, sr6 1.281, sr8 1.094, alpha6 14.0; E-01 completed no dispersion-corrected energy
method.basis: 6-31G(d,p) on all atoms except iodine; LANL2DZ with its effective core potential on iodine
method.basis_input_note: 6-31G** is the comma-free spelling of 6-31G(d,p) and resolves to the same installed file

schedule.run_order: prescribed guesses in order; then the analytic gradient on the reference solution; then 24 displaced points; then an independent repeat of the gradient job; then (precursor only) the Hartree-Fock stability diagnostic

precursor.gradient_reference: lowest-energy converged RKS solution; ties within 1e-6 Eh resolved by core, then SAD

finite_differences.frame: engine Bohr coordinates of the reference geometry, rebuilt with units bohr, no_com, no_reorient, symmetry c1

schedule.repeat: independent rerun of the gradient job in a fresh process with fresh scratch; compared at 1e-8 Eh and 1e-6 au

implementation.gradient: energy with the wavefunction returned, then an analytic gradient on that wavefunction with finite-difference fallback disabled
implementation.analytic_unavailable: the 24 displaced points and the repeat still run; the comparison row is INDETERMINATE; reproducibility compares energies only
implementation.S2: the last value printed by the engine for each unrestricted guess job; if absent, the dependent criteria are downgraded, never substituted
implementation.lowdin_spins: engine one-electron property LOWDIN_SPINS for the activated guesses; if absent, the localization hypothesis is not evaluable
implementation.hf_stability: planned extraction: the result would be recorded as unavailable (INDETERMINATE), because the inspected driver code of the installed build returns no machine-readable result for the CHECK mode; the diagnostic was not run in E-01
implementation.guards: symmetry c1; engine geometry equal to the input within 1e-8 bohr before and after each job; Cartesian basis; iodine core-electron count and explicit electron count as recorded for the inputs; any deviation stops the species

stop_rules: any SCF non-convergence stops the species at once; no later job of that species runs
<S^2> >= 1.05 for a converged unrestricted guess stops the species at once
a resource-cap breach or any stopped job (engine error, guard, recentring) stops the species at once
unresolved resource or process-cleanup evidence blocks every further launch
nothing is retried, retuned or substituted

resource_envelope.per_job_wall: the remaining species aggregate at launch

preflight_feasibility.memory: free memory at least the engine memory plus 1 GiB
preflight_feasibility.scratch: arithmetic estimate, not engine-reported: with P = nbf(nbf+1)/2 and Q = P(P+1)/2, KS jobs 3 x Q x 8 bytes; the Hartree-Fock diagnostic 2 x Q x 8 bytes plus Q x 16 bytes
